name: ForCookie CMP – Automatic Cookie Banner
author: forcookie

sections.description:
ForCookie (forcookie) integrates cookie consent banners and compliance tools directly into your WordPress site. This plugin helps you manage cookie consent, implement GDPR compliance, and provide users with transparent cookie management.

Third-Party Service

This plugin uses the ForCookie external service for cookie validation and banner functionality:

  • Service URL: https://www.forcookie.com
  • Terms of Service: https://www.forcookie.com/en/terms-of-service/
  • Privacy Policy: https://www.forcookie.com/en/privacy-policy/
  • API Endpoint: https://api.forcookie.com/

The plugin sends your domain name and API key to the ForCookie service for license validation. The cookie banner script is loaded securely from ForCookie’s servers only after a valid API key is supplied by the site administrator.

Configuration

After activation, visit Settings > ForCookie to:
– Enter your API key
– View license information
– Enable/disable the cookie banner
– Check your subscription status

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Valid ForCookie API key (get one at https://www.forcookie.com/en/forcookie-install-wordpress-plugin/)

Features

  • Automatic cookie detection and blocking
  • GDPR compliance
  • CCPA compliance
  • Google Consent Mode v2 support
  • Easy API key setup
  • License status monitoring
  • Enable/disable functionality

Support

For support and questions, please visit https://www.forcookie.com or contact the support team.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
© ForCookie – https://www.forcookie.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin directory to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Navigate to Settings > ForCookie
  4. Enter your ForCookie API key
  5. The cookie banner will be automatically activated on your site
sections.faq:
How do I get an API key?

Visit https://www.forcookie.com/en/forcookie-install-wordpress-plugin/ to create an account and obtain your API key.

Which regulations does ForCookie support?

ForCookie helps you comply with GDPR, CCPA, Google Consent Mode v2, and other cookie regulations.

Where can I find more information about ForCookie?

For more information, visit https://www.forcookie.com or contact info@forcookie.com

What data is shared with ForCookie?

The plugin shares your domain name and API key with ForCookie for license validation. Please review their privacy policy at https://www.forcookie.com/en/privacy-policy/
